fact: Mauritania's Code de commerce provides a beneficial owner register kept by the commercial-register greffe of the competent commercial court, which may be held electronically and is not public; access is limited to the entity's representative, AML authorities, reporting entities and persons with a court-authorised legitimate interest.
title: Propriété effective : règles et procédures de collecte, de vérification et d'utilisation des informations
publisher: Groupe multipartite national (GMN) de la Mauritanie, FiTI
